test_title: SSC CPO 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On 11 Nov 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Two Statements are given followed by two conclusions numbered I and II. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

All trees are rocks.

All rocks are cups.

**Conclusions:**

I. All trees are cups.

II. Some cups are trees.

options.text: Neither conclusion I nor II follows
Both conclusions I and II follow.

solution:
Explanation:

The least possible Venn Diagram is as follows:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1ae941c87c49436653f63a8b75a61285816b7476b816ab80584f7b8f3c0259c7.png] 

Conclusions:

I. All trees are cups. → Follows (because all trees are rocks and all rocks are cups, so we can say that all trees are definitely cups.)

II. Some cups are trees. → Follows (because all trees are rocks and all rocks are cups, hence some cups are definitely trees.) 

Hence, “Both conclusions I and II follow.”.
